title: Smooth special and residue-field fibres on a prepared Popescu chart
statement: Let R and Cbar be commutative rings, pi in R, and compatible algebra structures R to Cbar and R/pi^2 to Cbar. Let d be prepared finite polynomial data [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation]: P=R[x_1,...,x_n], finitely many f_l, a_k, subsets E_k, coefficients h_{klj}, g_{kl}, and a surjection epsilon:(R/pi^2)[x] to Cbar with the prescribed kernel, smooth charts, conormal and differential bases, normalized coefficients and cleared relations. Put Q=P[z_1,...,z_m], u_l=f_l-pi z_l, p_{kl}=a_k z_l-sum_{j in E_k}h_{klj}z_j-pi g_{kl}, D=ULift(Q/(u_l,p_{kl})), and D_0=D/pi D. Let c:Cbar to D_0 be an R-algebra map taking epsilon(X_i) to the original generator x_i of D_0. Fix a prime q of D_0 and a chart k with c(epsilon(reduced(a_k))) outside q. Put qD equal to the inverse image of q in D, and p equal to its contraction to R. Let cmod:Cbar/pi Cbar to D_0 be a ring map whose composite with the quotient projection is c. Then the fibre ring kappa(p) tensor_R D is smooth at the prime corresponding to qD [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal]. Also the principal localization (D_0)_{c(epsilon(reduced(a_k)))} is smooth over Cbar/pi Cbar for the algebra structure induced by cmod [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. No annihilator or Noetherian hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Lift t=c(epsilon(reduced(a_k))) to s in D using quotient surjectivity. Its image avoids qD since t avoids q. Contract qD to p in Spec R. The image of pi is zero modulo pi D, hence pi belongs to p and maps to zero in its residue field B. Its square also maps to zero, so the quotient universal property gives a compatible R/(pi squared)-algebra structure on B.

Apply the zero-base chart polynomial model with B=kappa(p), using the chosen s. Prepared.smooth says the reduced coefficient chart is smooth over R/(pi squared). Its scalar extension to B is smooth by Smooth.baseChange; its polynomial extension is smooth by the polynomial instances and Smooth.comp. Transport by the B-algebra equivalence to obtain Smooth B of the fibre localization at 1 tensor s.

The inverse of preimageEquivFiber contracts a fibre prime through includeRight. Its inverse law therefore identifies membership of 1 tensor s in the corresponding fibre prime with membership of s in qD. Thus this chart element avoids the fibre prime and the smooth principal localization witnesses IsSmoothAtPrime.

Apply the special-chart polynomial model. Principal localization of C0 at a0 is smooth over C0, the finite polynomial algebra over it is smooth, and Smooth.comp gives smoothness over C0. Transport by the C0-algebra equivalence, with the structural map given by cmod, to obtain the second clause. Pair it with the residue-field smoothness witness.

lean.statement:
theorem popescu_lift_chart_fibres (R : Type a) (Cbar : Type c)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] [Algebra R Cbar] (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (hd : d.Prepared)
    (c : Cbar →ₐ[R] (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (cmod : (Cbar ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar)) →+*
      (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
        Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (hc : ∀ i : Fin d.n, c (d.ε (MvPolynomial.X i)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (d.x i))
    (hcmod : cmod.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) = c.toRingHom)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (k : Fin d.r) (hk : c (d.ε (d.reduced (d.a k))) ∉ q.asIdeal) :
    let qD := PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) q
    let p := PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra) qD
    IsSmoothAtPrime p.asIdeal.ResidueField
      (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R d.liftingAlgebra p ⟨qD, rfl⟩) ∧
    @Smooth (Cbar ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar)) _
      (Localization.Away (c (d.ε (d.reduced (d.a k))))) _
      (letI := cmod.toAlgebra; inferInstance)
